projectBriefDesc: This project is an API automation testing framework designed to validate REST APIs
projectDesc: This project is an API automation testing framework designed to validate REST APIs with a focus on: scalable test structure, reusable components, strong coverage of positive, negative, and edge cases, maintainability as test volume grows. The framework is built to simulate real-world API testing scenarios with clean architecture and reporting support.

projectBriefDesc: Snake & Ladder Multiplayer Game — Full-Stack Real-Time System A full-stack, real-time Snake & Ladder game featuring both single-player and multiplayer modes.
projectDesc: This project is a full-stack, real-time Snake & Ladder game supporting both single-player (against AI) and multiplayer modes. It demonstrates modern web architecture with real-time communication, containerization, and automated testing. The system is fully Dockerized, tested using Playwright, and designed with clear separation between frontend, backend, and game logic.

projectBriefDesc: A full end-to-end and API automation project built using Playwright with TypeScript, focused on testing real-world user flows, handling flaky behavior, and structuring a scalable test framework.
projectDesc:
This project was developed over ~8 days as a complete automation 
 solution covering: 
 ✅ UI Functional Testing 
    ✅ End-to-End (E2E) Flows 
    ✅ API Testing 
    ✅ Edge Case Detection 
 It includes 61 automated tests (UI + API), with documented failures highlighting real issues in the target application.
